description:
From docs/suite-decreases-s393.md (#315 diagnosis).  Every packagev.t row that validates a version string via version::is_strict dies with undef-fn.

LAYER: lib/version.pm shim (CLAUDE.md 9a) — module behavior, NOT runtime.  Implement is_strict (and check its sibling is_lax while there — same regex family, perl distributes both in version/regex.pm).

BAR: probe against real perl on the strings packagev.t feeds it; re-run op/packagev.t and splice its snapshot row with the cause; corpus-diff (expect identical — lib/ change makes the sweep NON-OPTIONAL per s377 rule); gate.

=== DONE s395d.  lib/version.pm gained is_strict and is_lax, each as ONE literal pattern (perl composes them from qr-in-qr in version/regex.pm, which PCL would have to compile as qr objects).  Verified against the real version:: over all 40 strings op/packagev.t feeds them plus 12 more -- every answer agrees, both predicates.  op/packagev.t 5 -> 198 ok (+193).  Guard: new Pl/t/version-shim-01.t, 2 rows, 3 s.
